MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 17
   C. 15
   D. 21

2. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

3. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 14

4. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 82

5. Solve for x: x + 8 = 20. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 20
   C. 13
   D. 12

6. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

7. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15

8. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

9. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 25
   D. 10

10. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 28
   C. 33
   D. 14

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 30
   C. 36
   D. 45

13. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 29
   C. 23.7
   D. 23.6

14. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

15. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19.6

16. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

17. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 56
   C. 1
   D. 57

18. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 81
   C. 40.5
   D. 9

19. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.6
   D. 31.7

20. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

21. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 49

22. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 17
   D. 8

23. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 90

24. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
